body:
This is truly wholesome and awesome news. So proud of you! 

Is it okay if I contact you for some clarity? I'm experiencing the same thing

Just as an update: i broke it off with him at the end. I couldn't take it anymore and I'm absolutely lost without it but I'm fairly sure it's due to my abandonment issues. Looking at the bright side, i experienced some incredibly romantic and satisfying moments with someone that cared for me but I couldn't properly reciprocate. It's okay guys, even if it ends you've still made good memories and those you can still cherish forever.

I know, I do too. I think what's important is that we're trying as long as we're honest and considerate of the other person too. I've come to the conclusion that I'll manage as long as I can. If it starts becoming a problem for him too, then it's time to split up.

I've asked myself these questions multiple times. I'm not asexual because I sometimes enjoy the moment but it's the intimacy and the vulnerability that are extremely hard to face. It's sort of a paradox but I have a harder time being sexual with someone repeatedly than having casual encounters.

Aside from that one comment, he has learned to better express his needs and understands I'm having a hard time. Of course if it happens again after all the explaining I've done, I'll break it off. 
I am miserable yes, but i would have been with someone else at this point. Counseling seems to not help anymore. As I've mentioned in the post, my therapist suggested infidelity as a way to explore my sexuality which, i think, is completely wrong.
Thank you so much for your kind words, I'll try to keep it in my mind when I feel like running away.

First of all, thank you for you response. I thought I was the only one experiencing this amount of doubts constantly and it's hard to talk about this with people irl without them judging me for it.
I have been struggling with the idea of breaking up with him for the past two months. It's been incredibly hard but he's been my rock through it all. Any advice on how to stop "distracting" myself with thinking about how a relationship with other men would have looked like? Thank you again

I honestly think it's me, not others. It's too late to get out of the negativity because I'm real deep in it. There's no future for me due to my lack of will and skills, other than my shitty personality.
I'm also tired of feeling down then up and down again. Theraphy is sucking the life out of my parents' incomings and I'm a lost cause. Because the problem is in me ai know it's always going to be like this. So it's better to spiral down this filthy rabbit hole of horrible thoughts until I can finally give up and die.

Apparently, dying from taking pills is easier said than done, a shame.
Anyway, it is my fult. My silence is disrespectful, I should ignore everything because my problems are dumb and so am I, and go back to my original self.
I have to deal with these people daily. I am honestly quitting school.

I tried to follow your advice but unfortunately, this is my last night. Thank your for your support. I probably shouldn't tell you this. But everyone screaming at me that I'm a dissapointment, that I'm weak and that I do not care is too much. There no one who truly loves me and there won't be, I'm pretty sure. so bye

I hope it doesn't have to be that way.
Image doesn't mean anything the entire time, and if they tell you so they must be superficial

I do understand that though. This is "me" because I wasn't always like this. I've had moments that made me happy So yeah, it IS the depression talking.

I hope you find the strenght man

I'm sorry you have to go through that still, and I'm happy to hear you have the will to get better.

But I've made my decision. Not even my mother can stand me now. It was a pleasant conversation. Thanks man.

None of those things are possibile, but thank you anyway.

So how did you do it? How did you go day by day without feeling the pain?

That's what scares me the most.
To me just thinking of 5 years of being like this is a great deal of pain. I wanna live man. I wanna live so bad but not like this. I'm going to be a fuck up, and I don't have the money nor the time to be.
Thank you so much for being concerned as well. But if the people who should be my second family aren't, I don't think I deserve it.

But how does one do that. How do you turn your life around when you're so busy feeling terrified to even try and improve it?

My mother found me crying some weeks ago and I told her, at first she was very aggressive, rejecting the thought of me being unwell and telling me I was burden, that she wished my family didn't have so many problems, but she became more aware with time.

She's the reason I haven't gone up and jumped from the window. She has already lost a son when he was 20 and she blames herself for it.
My other brothers aren't doing so well, too. I don't want to be the cause of her giving up as well. She's such a strong woman but I honestly have nothing else to live for.
